js: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div')).find(d => /^BETA v/.test(d.innerText.trim()) && d.children.length < 6); const t = document.getElementById('k_takeaway'); const r = e => { const x = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return [Math.round(x.left), Math.round(x.right)]; }; return {banner: r(b), takeaway: r(t), sidebar: r(document.querySelector('.well'))}; })()
